meta.description: A comprehensive verification system for Kiro sessions.

copy.tagline: 验证 Kiro 会话的正确性与完整性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保 Kiro 会话的可靠运行。
copy.tagline_en: Verify correctness and completeness of Kiro sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure reliable operation of Kiro sessions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你完成代码修改后，自动执行构建检查、类型检查、代码规范检查、测试、安全扫描和差异审查，最后生成一份验证报告，告诉你代码是否准备好提交 PR。
howto.when: 当你完成一个功能或重要代码修改后、创建 PR 前、重构后，或者想确保代码质量时，可以要求 Claude 运行验证。

say.text: 帮我运行验证循环，检查当前代码。
say.note: Claude 会执行所有验证阶段并生成报告。
触发持续模式下的验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically run build verification, type checking, linting, tests, security scan, and diff review when you complete code changes, then produce a verification report indicating if the code is ready for a PR.
howto.when_en: Invoke this skill after completing a feature or significant code change, before creating a PR, after refactoring, or when you want to ensure quality gates pass.

say_en.text: Run the verification loop on the current code.
say_en.note: Claude will execute all phases and generate a report.
